storyCards.headline: Lady: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
D'angelo's "Lady" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Lady" is a song co-written, co-produced and performed by American neo soul singer D'Angelo, issued as the third single from his debut studio album, Brown Sugar (1995).

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Lady was released in 1995.
